lines: 玄天宗，外门杂役堂。
“所有人收拾好行李，一炷香之内到广场集合。”
杂役管事的声音响彻在一众杂役房内。
杂役房内顿时嘈杂一片，这些新入门的杂役弟子，有人匆忙收拾行李，有人则早已收拾好行李，直接就往广场方向奔行。
今天，是杂役们分派差使的日子。从今以后，他们这些杂役将会被分配到宗门各处，这次分派也将决定他们未来的人生走向。
“李牧火，你快点儿，得赶紧去占个好位置。”
某间杂役房里，一个身高一米七五，约十五六岁的少年，正不紧不慢地收拾着行李。
他的身边，一个瘦弱的少年一边催促着，一边帮他收拾床垫被褥。
这人名叫王全，是与李牧火一起被接引进的宗门，因资质问题，又一起被留在了杂役堂待分配，于是两人自然就成了好友。
王全似有些兴奋道：“我打听过了，外门最好的去处有三处，分别是药谷，丹房和膳房。药谷里栽种各种灵草宝药，若能得上一两株，那便是大机缘。丹房也经常会有灵丹赏赐下来，机缘同样不小。膳房虽没什么修行机缘，可伙食据说一等一的好。待会儿记得表现好点儿，该争咱就得争……”
李牧火见王全挺急的，也就加快了手上动作，嘴上则忍不住提醒道：“别只盯着那些好的差使，你想去，别人自然也想去，未必能轮得到你，你最好给自己定个备选目标。”
王全则自信道：“无妨，我打小给我爹帮厨，进膳房应该不是问题。倒是你，可有什么想法，如果不知道怎么选的话，可以跟着我走，我教你烹饪。”
李牧火正欲开口，却被王全打断道：“即便不跟我去，有两处也是坚决不能去的。”
“哪两处？怎么就不能去了？”
李牧火背起偌大布包，略带疑惑地问道。
“你没听说吗？当然是炼器房和巡山杂役了，炼器房杂役要劈柴烧火，拉风箱，清铁屑，甚至有时候还会被拉去挖矿，是公认的最苦最累的。巡山杂役倒是不算太累，可危险啊，听说每年都有好些巡山杂役会被妖兽袭击，稍有不慎就英年早逝了，偏偏巡山杂役是招人最多的……”
李牧火闻言却是眼睛微微一亮：“哦，这么说大家应该都不太会选炼器房杂役和巡山杂役了？”
“想肯定是不想的，但实在没人去的话，说是会直接分派，也不知道哪个倒霉蛋会被分派过去。”
一路聊着，两人很快就来到了杂役堂广场，此时这里已经汇聚了几百号新入门的杂役弟子。
在王全的努力拼挤下，两人终于占据了靠前排的位置。
很快，一炷香时间便到了。
所有杂役弟子整齐排列，杂役主管这会儿也领着很多身着宗门制式衣服的外门弟子前来。
杂役主管脸色严肃对李牧火等人说道：“待会儿分派去处，例行问询时，所有人都要诚实，莫要撒谎。否则后果很严重，可能会被直接逐出宗门，都听到了没有？”
“听到了。”
广场上众人神情忐忑，谁不想有个好点儿的去处？有人甚至已经编好了“种植”和“炼丹”等人生经历，此刻却因这一句话纷纷收敛了心思。
相比于逐出宗门，能留下来才是最重要的，杂役弟子再苦再累，那也是普通人遥不可及的。
待杂役主管说完，便有外门弟子上前。
“药谷缺十名杂役，曾有摘花种草经验的，略懂药理和分拣药材的出列。”
当即，人群中直接出列了二十多人，李牧火身边，王全想出列又将脚缩了回来，显然被主管的那句逐出宗门给吓住了。
那外门弟子于这二十几名杂役弟子中，只精选了十个接触过药理的人便离开了。剩下的人只得垂着脑袋回到了队伍里。
接着。
“丹房缺六名杂役，同样需要略懂药理的……”
“膳房招杂役二十人，有烹饪经验的出列，别想蒙混进来，进膳房后是要验菜考核的。”
这次，王全连忙出列，临走前还跟李牧火道：“兄弟，你来吗？”
李牧火微笑着摇头：“膳房很好，可惜不适合我。刚才没来得及说，我家其实是开铁匠铺的。”
王全愣了一下，可当下他也没机会再多说，只得迅速出列。
紧跟着。
“兽栏招收十二名杂役，要求有驯兽和喂养灵禽的经验。”
“藏经阁缺八名整理书卷的杂役，要求能识文断字，整理书稿，记叙杂事。”
content_en:
Xuantian Sect, Outer Gate Miscellaneous Hall.
"Everyone pack their bags and gather in the square within a stick of incense."
The voice of the handyman steward resounded throughout the handyman rooms.
The handyman's room suddenly became noisy. Some of these new servant disciples were packing their luggage in a hurry, while others had already packed their luggage and ran directly towards the square.
Today is the day for the handymen to dispatch their errands. From now on, these handymen will be assigned to various parts of the sect, and this assignment will also determine their future life direction.
"Li Muhuo, hurry up, you have to get a good position quickly."
In a certain utility room, a young man of about fifteen or sixteen years old, one meter tall and seventy-five meters tall, was packing his luggage unhurriedly.
Beside him, a thin young man urged him while helping him pack the mattress and bedding.
This man's name was Wang Quan, and he was introduced to the sect together with Li Muhuo. Due to qualification issues, they were both left in the handyman hall to be assigned, so the two naturally became good friends.
Wang Quan seemed a little excited and said: "I have inquired, and there are three best places to go in the outer gate, namely the medicine valley, the alchemy room and the dining room. Various spiritual herbs and precious medicines are planted in the medicine valley. If you can get one or two, it is a great opportunity. The alchemy room will often be rewarded with spiritual elixirs, and the opportunity is also not small. Although the dining room has no opportunities for practice, the food is said to be first-class. Remember to behave better later, and we have to fight for it..."
Seeing that Wang Quan was in a hurry, Li Muhuo speeded up his hand movements and couldn't help but remind him: "Don't just focus on the good ones. If you want to go, others will naturally want to go too. It may not be your turn. You'd better set an alternative target for yourself."
Wang Quan said confidently: "It doesn't matter. I've been helping my father cook since I was a kid, so getting into the dining room shouldn't be a problem. But if you have any ideas, if you don't know what to choose, you can follow me and I'll teach you how to cook."
Li Muhuo was about to speak, but was interrupted by Wang Quan: "Even if you don't come with me, there are two places that you definitely can't go to."
"Which two places? Why can't you go?"
Li Muhuo picked up the big cloth bag and asked with a little doubt.
"Haven't you heard? Of course, it's the refining room and the mountain patrol handymen. The refining room handymen have to chop firewood, blow the bellows, clean iron filings, and are even sometimes dragged to mine. They are recognized as the most difficult and tiring. The mountain patrol handymen are not too tired, but they are dangerous. I heard that every year, many mountain patrol handymen are attacked by monsters and die young if they are not careful. However, the mountain patrol handymen are the ones who recruit the most people..."
Li Muhuo's eyes lit up slightly when he heard this: "Oh, so everyone should be less able to choose the handyman in the refinery room or the handyman on the mountain patrol?"
"I definitely don't want to, but if no one is going, they will be assigned directly. I don't know which unlucky guy will be assigned."
Chatting all the way, the two people soon arrived at the Jiaozuo Hall Square, where hundreds of new Jiaoyi disciples had gathered.
With Wang Quan's hard work, the two finally occupied the front row position.
Soon, it was time to burn incense.
All the handyman disciples lined up neatly, and the handyman supervisor also led many outer disciples wearing sect uniforms.
The handyman supervisor said to Li Muhuo and others with a serious face: "Everyone must be honest during routine inquiries when they are assigned to places later. Don't lie. Otherwise, the consequences will be serious, and you may be directly expelled from the sect. Did you all hear that?"
"I heard it."
Everyone in the square looked anxious. Who doesn't want to have a better place to go? Some people have even compiled their life experiences such as "planting" and "refining alchemy", but at this moment, they all restrained their minds because of this sentence.
Compared with being expelled from the sect, being able to stay is the most important thing. No matter how hard and tired the handyman disciples are, it is still beyond the reach of ordinary people.
After the handyman supervisor finished speaking, some outer disciples came forward.
"The Medicine Valley is short of ten handymen. Those who have experience in picking flowers and planting grass, and who have some knowledge of pharmacology and sorting medicinal materials will be listed."
Immediately, more than 20 people came out of the crowd. Next to Li Muhuo, Wang Quan wanted to go out but then retracted his feet. He was obviously frightened by the supervisor's words about expulsion from the sect.
The outer disciple only selected ten people who had been exposed to pharmacology among the twenty or so handyman disciples and left. The remaining people had no choice but to hang their heads and return to the team.
then.
"The alchemy room is short of six handymen, and they also need someone with a little knowledge of pharmacology..."
"The dining room is recruiting twenty handymen. Those with cooking experience will be on the list. Don't try to sneak in. After entering the dining room, you will be tested for food."
This time, Wang Quan hurriedly came out of the queue, and before leaving, he said to Li Muhuo: "Brother, are you coming?"
Li Muhuo smiled and shook his head: "The dining room is very good, but it's a pity that it's not suitable for me. I didn't have time to mention it just now, but my family actually runs a blacksmith shop."
Wang Quan was stunned for a moment, but at the moment he had no chance to say anything more, so he had to get out of the queue quickly.
Follow closely.
"The animal pen recruits twelve handymen, and they are required to have experience in training animals and raising spiritual birds."
"The Sutra Pavilion is short of eight handymen to organize books. They are required to be able to read and hyphenate, organize manuscripts, and record miscellaneous things."
